coverage.evidence: Both pages sit in the Access group of Settings: dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:83,91,92, labeled Access at dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:961, with nav labels Blocked terms and Banned people at en.json:922-923. Route actions are moderation:read (banned/route.ts:21) and moderation:filter:read (blocked-terms/route.ts:50). Seeded defaults are moderation:read Mod, moderation:unban Mod, moderation:filter:read Mod and moderation:blocklist:write LeadModerator (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:241,247,255,287), on the ladder Mod=10 < LeadModerator=20 < Editor=30 < Broadcaster=40 (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51-54). A channel can adjust an action level within [Floor, Broadcaster] (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Identity/ActionLevelPolicy.cs:44). The Unban button is gated by can('moderation:unban') (BannedView.vue:76). The add panel and Unblock are gated by canEdit = moderation:blocklist:write (BlockedTermsView.vue:42,69,94).

Unban calls DELETE moderation/bans/{userId} and then invalidates the list (dashboard/src/api/bans.ts:52-64). Block posts the term and takes the returned list (api/blockedTerms.ts:130-143), and the field clears on success (BlockedTermsView.vue:49-51). Submit sends the trimmed value (BlockedTermsView.vue:43-48), the button is disabled while the trimmed text is empty (BlockedTermsView.vue:80), and Enter submits the form (BlockedTermsView.vue:73). Unblock removes every case-insensitive match (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/ModerationService.cs:1036-1060). The quoted texts match the i18n files: Banned by {name} {when}, Nobody is banned in your channel., {name} could not be unbanned., The banned people could not be loaded. (banned/i18n/en.json:8-12), and Block a word or phrase, Block, Blocked now, Nothing is blocked yet., Unblock, The term could not be blocked: {reason}, The term could not be unblocked: {reason}, The blocked terms could not be loaded. (blocked-terms/i18n/en.json:7-16). A row with a reason shows reason · when (BannedView.vue:45-47), and relative time uses Intl.RelativeTimeFormat (dashboard/src/lib/time.ts:274,294-299). The newest ban is first via OrderByDescending(BannedAt) (ModerationService.cs:934), and timeouts are skipped (ModerationService.cs:915). Try again is common.panel.retry (dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:102), emitted as retry by PanelCard.vue:219-220.

The banned list is read through the broadcaster token: TwitchHelixAuth.User with broadcasterId and the moderation:read scope (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Transport/Helix/SubClients/TwitchModerationApi.cs:272-300). A failed read returns an error, never an empty list (ModerationService.cs:887-905), and the panel shows the error state first (dashboard/src/composables/usePanelState.ts:29-30). Unban is signed by the operator's own token with moderator_id set to the operator (TwitchModerationApi.cs:186-214, called at ModerationService.cs:212). Blocked-term add, remove and read use the operator's own token (ModerationService.cs:990,1049,2038), and Twitch enforces that the operator moderates the channel (TwitchModerationApi.cs:589-591). The remedy pages are real: Continue as broadcaster (dashboard/src/views/site/login/i18n/en.json:24) and the Home Connections panel (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/home/i18n/en.json:122-123). Re-sign-in as broadcaster asks for the held scopes plus the recorded gaps (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Identity/AuthService.cs:243-269).

Unban and Unblock call mutate directly with no confirm dialog (BannedView.vue:50-54,82; BlockedTermsView.vue:57-62,100). Source comments say re-applying undoes them (BannedView.vue:12-13; BlockedTermsView.vue:13-14), and the banned explain text says Banning them again undoes it (banned/i18n/en.json:6). Both act on Twitch right away (ModerationService.cs:212-222,1047-1053). Bot rules are a separate system with delete, timeout and ban actions (ModerationService.cs:410-412), so the page's statements that blocking creates no NomNomzBot filter and that bot filters delete on top of the Twitch list hold. Removing a blocked term touches only blocked terms (ModerationService.cs:1008-1066).

reader_answers.evidence: The Access group, both page names, the Unban, Block and Unblock buttons and Enter-to-submit match settingsNavigation.ts:83-92, banned/i18n/en.json:11, blocked-terms/i18n/en.json:10,13 and BlockedTermsView.vue:73,80.

The operator token and Twitch's moderator check are at TwitchModerationApi.cs:186-214 and 589-591. The broadcaster token read with its error path is at TwitchModerationApi.cs:272-300 and ModerationService.cs:887-905. The role defaults are at ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:241,247,255,287, and overrides are clamped at ActionLevelPolicy.cs:44.

The row leaves the list after the unban refetch (api/bans.ts:64). The term appears and the field empties (api/blockedTerms.ts:143; BlockedTermsView.vue:49-51). The term leaves after unblock (api/blockedTerms.ts:166). Failure toasts carry the reason (BlockedTermsView.vue:52-53,59-60; BannedView.vue:52).

Unblock needs moderation:blocklist:write, which defaults to LeadModerator (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:287). For a user without it, the Unblock button is hidden (BlockedTermsView.vue:94). RemoveBlockedTermAsync touches only blocked terms, so the ban stays (ModerationService.cs:1008-1066).
